execution.progress: Paid work in three one-round stages whose exact job, reserved unit and position persist across interruption; resume pays only the next stage after revalidation; completion, failure, cancellation and death settle once. Observe and remove are single rounds; growth proceeds only in ordinary simulation.

details.costs: Study: 2 rounds. Establish: inputStackId names one whole owned, untreated, unspoiled root unit (quantity 1) gathered from a living root plant (target, if given, must be that plant); x, y name a 0.25 m position within reach (0.65 m plus body radius) on ordinary meadow soil (.) inside the world, not standing water, waterlogging at most 0.1, soil moisture 0.3-1.2, at least 0.6 m from any object and clear of people, with fewer than 3 root plants or unfinished trials within 5 m. Three paid stages of one round and 1 energy each: prepare the position, place the unit, cover and record; establish pays the first and the same action continues each round. Resume pays the next stage after rechecking reach, site, unit and energy; cancel takes one round and no energy; processId selects the work. Observe: target a trial position or a plant source in reach, one round and 0.2 energy (the baseline probe observation). Remove (planter only): target in reach, one round and 1 energy. Tend has no supported intervention yet and is refused at no cost. Harvest uses gather at its own cost. No tool, water, fertilizer or seed is provided.
details.effects: The unit stays carried, owned and ageing until the placing stage moves it, with its origin, mass and age, out of the inventory into the position; then it cannot be eaten or planted elsewhere. Covering makes the position a planted root propagule under the existing plant rules: it gains establishment only from actual temperature, light, soil moisture and season, so cold, darkness, drought or waterlogging stall it, and if the buried unit spoils under the existing ageing law first, the trial dies. When establishment completes the unit becomes a new root plant (it leaves the food stocks) with no stock and a stock ceiling of at most 4, regrowing under the same growth rule as natural root plants and harvested by anyone only through gather; nothing is copied, reset or guaranteed. After 80 planted rounds without establishing or dying the trial reports an inconclusive status and continues. Observe records only visible stage, stock, soil and weather as an unverified personal record; repeated probe observations follow the existing evidence rules. Work not continued in a round pauses; too little energy, leaving reach or a changed site pauses without charge; a lost or spoiled unit stops the work. Cancel returns an unplaced unit once and leaves a placed unit uncovered in the position, where it does not establish. Death drops an unplaced unit where the person died and leaves placed or planted units to the ecology. Remove returns a placed or covered unit in its current condition, nothing for a dead trial, never an established plant, and clears the position. No reward, milestone or refund.

packet.access: Omission is not absence. Query abilities, own inventory, knowledge, projects, memory, state or personally observed objects in batches. Ability search/list returns compact catalogue entries; use exact ids for full interface details and applicability. Search results are indexes. Exact queries return one record per offset. All paged records use600-code-unit fragments with zero-based part0..parts-1, consistently in proactive and queried views. Current-scope retained queries are reprojected using these stable pages; original results remain archived. Queries expose no hidden properties, other private records or historical capabilities. Queries do not perform physical trials or award experience. Exact-id queries return a complete record of up to 4000 code units as one value in a single result; larger records keep the paged form.
